title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: governance policies check outgoing emails before they are sent
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, governance paths, table operations and documented credit consumption are supported. The updated billing page still supports the billing description. Several checklist controls lack corresponding table rows, a minor completeness issue.

claims.quote: "status": "Launched", "statusKey": "launched"

claims.claim: The roadmap target is June CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "June CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap preview date is May CY2026.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "May CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap lists General Availability and Preview release phases.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Risk assessment
claims.claim: Governance evaluates representative-written and AI-generated outbound email before sending.
claims.quote: The system checks outbound messages, including AI-generated messages and messages written by customer service representatives, against configurable policies

claims.claim: Each drafted email is checked against active administrator-defined policies.
claims.quote: The system checks each email drafted by a service representative or an AI agent against active policies.

claims.claim: Flag noncompliant content records violations silently.
claims.quote: Flag noncompliant content: Silently records policy violations for auditing purposes. No warning is displayed.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Warn noncompliant content displays a warning but lets the sender proceed.
claims.quote: Warn noncompliant content: Displays a warning when policy violations are detected, but allows the email to be sent.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Open questions; rationales
claims.claim: The use page describes Block noncompliant content as preventing sending until violations are resolved.
claims.quote: Block noncompliant content: Prevents the email from being sent until the policy violations are resolved.

claims.claim: Governance is within Quality management.
claims.quote: Governance is a capability within Quality management

claims.claim: Quality Evaluation Agent powers governance.
claims.quote: Quality Evaluation Agent powers the governance capabilities.

claims.claim: Governance applies only to Dynamics 365 Customer Service.
claims.quote: Governance, which helps enforce compliance policies for outgoing customer communications. ... This feature applies only to Dynamics 365 Customer Service.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Governance requires administrator enablement rather than arriving enforced automatically.
claims.quote: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; cost; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Consumption licensing and variable cost reflect the documented Copilot Credits consumption.
claims.quote: Each prompt generation consumes Microsoft Copilot credits.

claims.where: summary; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot credits setup is a governance prerequisite.
claims.quote: Set up Microsoft Copilot credits.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The governance pages name no separate governance licence.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 Customer Service governance policies license required Enterprise Premium; opened configure/use governance policies, setup-pay-as-you-go and Customer Service pricing. Governance prerequisites name credits and roles, not a separate governance licence.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No credit rate for governance email checks at send time is published in the sources found.
claims.quote: Searched: "governance" "email" "Copilot Credits" "rate"; Dynamics 365 Customer Service governance email checks Copilot Credits rate licensing Quality Evaluation Agent. Opened governance pages, setup-pay-as-you-go, Copilot Studio Billing rates and management, and Customer Service pricing.

claims.claim: Copilot Service admin center > Customer Support > Quality management > Governance > Manage > Governance reaches the governance toggle.
claims.quote: in Customer Support > select Quality management. ... select Manage for Governance. ... On the Governance page, turn on the toggle for governance.

claims.claim: PATCH /msdyn_governanceagent_statuses(msdyn_governanceagent_statusid) updates governance status with the writable msdyn_isenabled property.
claims.quote: Update ... PATCH /msdyn_governanceagent_statuses(msdyn_governanceagent_statusid) ... Writable columns/attributes ... msdyn_isenabled

claims.claim: The reference describes msdyn_isenabled as whether the governance agent is enabled.
claims.quote: column indicating whether governance agent is enabled or not

claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly say the UI toggle writes msdyn_isenabled.
claims.quote: Searched: "governance" "msdyn_isenabled"; opened Configure governance policies and msdyn_governanceagent_status reference. The UI procedure and enabled-column description are documented, but no passage explicitly connects the toggle's write to that column.

claims.claim: Copilot Service workspace > Service > Governance > New policy > Add a policy > Content to check > How strictly to enforce reaches policy enforcement options.
claims.quote: In Copilot Service workspace, go to Service > Governance. ... If you select New policy, then on the Add a policy dialog ... In the Content to check section ... How strictly to enforce

claims.claim: POST /msdyn_guardrail_rules creates a governance policy record, not a complete enforcement configuration.
claims.quote: Create ... POST /msdyn_guardrail_rules ... PrimaryNameAttribute ... msdyn_name

claims.claim: The new policy record is named through msdyn_name in the request body.
claims.quote: Writable columns/attributes ... msdyn_name ... Description ... name of record ... LogicalName ... msdyn_name

claims.claim: The rule-table Create reference does not document content checks or enforcement strictness.
claims.quote: Searched: msdyn guardrail rule version enforcement strictness governance msdyn_isenabled toggle; read msdyn_guardrail_rule and msdyn_guardrail_rule_version references. The rule Create reference gives record creation, not the UI's content checks or enforcement strictness configuration.

claims.claim: Written by targets Customer service representatives or Autonomous AI.
claims.quote: Written by: Select Customer service representatives or Autonomous AI.

claims.claim: Supported attachment formats are .docx, .pdf and .txt.
claims.quote: Supported file formats are .docx, .pdf, and .txt.

claims.claim: Attachments are optionally evaluated as text only, excluding image content.
claims.quote: Attached files: Select the checkbox if you want to evaluate file attachments in addition to the email body. The system evaluates only text-based content; it ignores image content in attachments.

claims.claim: Policy strictness offers Low, Medium, High and Very High.
claims.quote: In the Policy strictness section, select from the following options: ... Low ... Medium ... High ... Very High

claims.claim: Medium is the default Policy strictness.
claims.quote: Medium: Default setting. Applies a balanced level of enforcement.

claims.claim: Very High includes minor deviations in its enforcement.
claims.quote: Very High: Applies the most aggressive enforcement, including minor deviations from policy definitions.

claims.claim: Default system policies include Email Template Adherence, Groundedness and Profanity.
claims.quote: select any of the default system policies, such as Email Template Adherence, Groundedness, or Profanity.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Administrators can simulate policy evaluation on sample email content.
claims.quote: Use simulation to test how a policy evaluates sample email content.

claims.claim: An Organization Records simulation can select up to 30 email records.
claims.quote: If you select Organization Records, add the conditions to select the email records to test. You can select up to 30 email records.

claims.claim: Excel Upload is another simulation data source.
claims.quote: Data source: Select Excel Upload or Organization Records.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Detection logs are on the Policy flags/blocks log tab of the Governance page.
claims.quote: View logs on the Policy flags/blocks log tab on the Governance page.

claims.claim: Violation reasoning and violation logs remain in English.
claims.quote: The violation reasoning and violation logs continue to appear in English.

claims.claim: A policy name can appear in configured languages when a violation is logged.
claims.quote: When the policy logs a violation, the policy name appears in the configured language.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrators need the CSR Manager security role.
claims.quote: Administrators need the CSR Manager security role.

claims.claim: Service representatives need the Customer Service Representative security role.
claims.quote: Service representatives need the Customer Service Representative security role.

claims.claim: Custom representative roles need Global Read on msdyn_governanceagent_status.
claims.quote: For custom roles assigned to service representatives, grant the Read privilege at Global access level for the msdyn_governanceagent_status table.

claims.claim: Custom administrator roles need Global Read, Create, Write, Delete, Append, Appendto and Assign on the listed governance tables.
claims.quote: For custom roles assigned to administrators, grant the Read, Create, Write, Delete, Append, Appendto, and Assign permissions at Global access level for the following tables

claims.claim: The custom-administrator prerequisite covers six tables, including both tables used by the controls rows.
claims.quote: msdyn_governanceagent_status; msdyn_guardrail_consumer_mapping; msdyn_guardrail_execution_info; msdyn_guardrail_rule; msdyn_guardrail_rule_version; msdyn_guardrail_scenariotype

claims.where: Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Providing consent for potential cross-region data movement is a documented prerequisite.
claims.quote: Provide consent for potential data movement across regions.

claims.claim: AI agents must be enabled for the Dynamics 365 environment in Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Enable AI agents for your Dynamics 365 environment in Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: Microsoft requires adequate notification to users that communications with representatives may be monitored, recorded or stored.
claims.quote: customers must adequately notify users that their communications with customer service representatives (service representatives or representatives) might be monitored, recorded, or stored.

claims.claim: Where applicable law requires, users' consent must be obtained before using the feature with them.
claims.quote: As required by applicable laws, customers must also obtain consent from users before they use this feature with them.

claims.claim: Microsoft says the feature should not be used for employment decisions.
claims.quote: It isn't intended to be used, and shouldn't be used, to make decisions that affect the employment of an employee or group of employees

claims.claim: Microsoft encourages informing service representatives that their communications may be monitored.
claims.quote: customers are encouraged to have a mechanism in place to inform their service representatives that their communications with users might be monitored, recorded, or stored.

claims.claim: Replacing the default Send button with a custom command bypasses automatic built-in governance validation.
claims.quote: If you replace the default Send button with a custom command, the built-in governance validation doesn't run automatically before an email is sent.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Custom Send code must invoke validateForSend before sending to integrate governance validation.
claims.quote: Always call validateForSend from your custom command before sending the email.

claims.claim: Customised Customer Service workspace apps may lack Governance in the site map and need the documented manual Power Apps steps.
claims.quote: When you're using a customized Customer Service workspace app, the Governance option might not appear in the site map. You need to manually add the Governance entry to the site map by using the Power Apps designer.

claims.claim: Conditions can select a subset of emails for checking.
claims.quote: Conditions for content: Add conditions to select a subset of emails that meet the conditions.

claims.claim: With no conditions, all emails in the check are evaluated.
claims.quote: If you don't select any conditions, the system evaluates all emails in the check.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Policy evaluation uses an LLM judgement rather than a simple literal rule match.
claims.quote: Score threshold for violation determination. LLM score less than threshold equals violated, score greater than or equal to threshold equals pass. ... msdyn_prompt ... prompt generated for guardrail rule

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Each policy prompt generation consumes Microsoft Copilot credits.
claims.quote: You must review the generated prompt. To refine the policy behavior, update the prompt instructions. Each prompt generation consumes Microsoft Copilot credits.

claims.claim: The Dynamics 365 billing page says selected Copilot and agent capabilities use consumption-based billing.
claims.quote: Selected Copilot and agent capabilities in Dynamics 365 use consumption-based billing, which charges per use.

claims.claim: These Dynamics 365 capabilities use Copilot Credits as their meter.
claims.quote: These capabilities use Copilot Credits for AI interactions and tasks, such as retrieving information and responding to prompts.

claims.claim: Both prepaid capacity and pay-as-you-go can be used in the same Dynamics 365 environment.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 supports two billing models: prepaid capacity and pay-as-you-go. ... You can use both billing models in the same Dynamics 365 environment.

claims.claim: Prepaid capacity is consumed first when both billing models are used.
claims.quote: Prepaid capacity is consumed first.

claims.claim: Learn does not identify the storage mapping for the UI's enforcement level or named Policy strictness options.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 governance policy msdyn_decisionthreshold Policy strictness How strictly to enforce; read rule and rule-version references and Use governance policies. A numeric LLM decision threshold and JSON rule definition are described, but not the mapping of the named UI options.

claims.claim: The custom Send documentation permits a sender to override a block, unlike the use page's description that violations must be resolved.
claims.quote: Block the email and display a dialog that explains which policies are violated. The user can override the restriction and send the email, or cancel.

claims.claim: The custom Send page says a block override is recorded.
claims.quote: The override is recorded.

claims.claim: Every control the checklist tells readers to take stock of, check or set has a corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: Checklist: role privileges, credits setup, cross-region consent, AI agents, simulations, custom Send validation, logs and consumption. Table: Whether governance is turned on for the environment; Creation of governance policy records.
claims.fix: Remove checklist instructions to take stock of role privileges, check credits setup, provide cross-region consent, confirm AI agents enablement, run simulations, check custom Send integration, review logs and monitor credits, because these have no corresponding table rows. Retain their sourced explanatory prose; do not add rows.

claims.claim: Learn documents governance policies as supporting the email channel.
claims.quote: Governance policies support the email channel

claims.claim: Policy authors review generated prompts and refine their instructions.
claims.quote: You must review the generated prompt. To refine the policy behavior, update the prompt instructions.

claims.claim: Administrators can adjust policy descriptions to refine the system prompts.
claims.quote: Adjust policy descriptions to refine system prompts.
